newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-HOLDERS FRANCE UNCHANGED AGAINST AUSTRALIA.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-HOLDERS FRANCE UNCHANGED AGAINST AUSTRALIA.

text.p: Holders France on Wednesday named an unchanged team of Cedric Pioline, Arnaud Boetsch, Guy Forget and Guillaume Raoux for their Davis Cup world group first-round tie against Australia in Sydney next month.

The French Tennis Federation said in a statement that captain Yannick Noah, already in Australia with his players, would decide nearer the February 7-9 tie on grass who would play singles and who would team up in the doubles.
Pioline and Boetsch played the singles and Forget and Raoux the doubles when France beat Sweden 3-2 in the final in Malmo last year.
